truthSource.label: EPA, Radiation sources and doses
truthSource.oneLine: Most of the radiation people receive is natural, from radon, rocks, soil and cosmic rays.

lesson.tip: Words like “all” and “never” fall to one counterexample. Radon and uranium are naturally radioactive.
